Name: Latency State
Description:
You magically compel yourself to enter a flow state, which you remain in until this spell ends. During this time you gain the following benefits:

• Your base movement speed increases by 10 feet.
• You cannot be charmed, enraged, or frightened.
• You may use your bonus action to make one weapon attack or move up to your base movement speed.
• You regain your reaction at the start of each turn.

**Sword Saint Bonus.** This spell is treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 5th level or higher, you gain one of the following effects for every two levels above 3rd:

• The weapon attacks made as part of a bonus action have advantage.
• You make one additional weapon attack when you use your bonus action to make one.
• When you would lose concentration, you may use your reaction to maintain it instead.
• Your movement speed increases by an additional 10 feet.
